description: Full-text search across published posts, pages, and custom post types. "results" are title and body matches from WordPress search; "acf_matches" are items whose ACF custom fields contain every search word (WordPress search skips ACF, and on many sites most text lives there). Use get_post to read a result.

include_acf.description: Also search ACF field values (first page only)

post_type.description: Limit to one post type slug (see list_post_types), e.g. "page" or "project"

name: search_content
title: Search site content
